name: Kagura Uzuki
source:
Hazuki's little sister, who is a very diligent and hardworking student.
Has a very gentle personality but is also quite shy. She's also very skilled at cooking.
However, her reckless sister always rushes her to finish.
She has a habit of still being half-asleep in the mornings and wetting her bed, which worries her greatly.
Compared to her sister, she holds low spiritual power. In order to develop her knowledge further, she supports Hazuki during her purifications.

"I... like you... Akira. I want... to be one with you..."

Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=595585]Getchu's[/url] official character description.
